components.title: Components
components.description: What the served version contains; null when not enumerated.

content_scan.description: The served version's content scan; null when it has not been scanned.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: Who created the Plugin; null when no creator is recorded.

description.title: Description
examples: Reviews pull requests against your team's conventions.

manifest_version.title: Manifest Version
manifest_version.description: The served version's manifest `version`, normalized for display, or `null` (the Plugin Version's `manifest_version` says how and when).

marketplace_id.title: Marketplace Id
marketplace_id.description: The ID of the plugin marketplace the Plugin lives in.

name.title: Name
name.description: Lowercase identifier, unique within its plugin marketplace. Fixed for an organization-owned Plugin's lifetime; a member-owned Plugin's changes when its owner renames it in claude.ai, while its `id` stays the same.

organization_installation_preference.title: Organization Installation Preference
organization_installation_preference.description: Organization-owned Plugin: the organization-wide installation setting every member gets unless an RBAC Group they belong to holds its own — the Plugin's own setting, or its plugin marketplace's default. Null for a member-owned Plugin, which has shares instead. One of `required`, `auto_install`, `available`, `not_available`; a value this API does not yet name is returned as stored.

organization_installation_preference_inh.title: Organization Installation Preference Inherited
organization_installation_preference_inh.description: Organization-owned Plugin: true while it has no organization-wide setting of its own and `organization_installation_preference` is its plugin marketplace's default. Null for a member-owned Plugin.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Who owns the Plugin: the organization, or the member whose personal plugin marketplace it lives in.

reach.title: Reach
reach.description:
How far the served version reaches, or `null` if it is not classified.

`remote` means it declares an MCP server or a CLI, or something that counts as one. `privileged` means it is not `remote`, but declares a hook (of any type, even one that posts to a URL), monitor, language server, Claude Code workflow (any file in a `workflows/` folder at its root counts as one), or settings, or has a skill, command, or other Markdown file whose frontmatter pre-approves tools (`allowed-tools` with any value other than an empty one or one that names only `AskUserQuestion`, `TodoWrite`, and `ToolSearch`). Otherwise it is `contained`.

If the frontmatter of a skill, command, or other Markdown file that could change the value could not be read, or was past a size limit, the version is `null` or `privileged` (or `remote`, if something else it declares makes it `remote`), not `contained`. The value is normally worked out when a version is stored, under the rules of that time, so an older version can be `null`, `contained` where the same files stored today would be `privileged`, `remote`, or `null`, or `privileged` where they would be `remote`.

served_version_id.title: Served Version Id
served_version_id.description: The version claude.ai serves to members.

served_version_pinned.title: Served Version Pinned
served_version_pinned.description: True once the served version has been pinned, through Update Plugin or in claude.ai. While false, a new version normally becomes the served version when it is stored. While the newest version is not the served version, as when a version saved in claude.ai is waiting for its content scan, `served_version_id` differs from `latest_version_id`.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: RFC 3339. Moves on a served-version change (including pinning an unpinned Plugin to the version it already serves) and, normally, on a new version. A version saved in claude.ai that waits for its content scan moves it when it becomes the served version, and not necessarily when it is stored. A change to the Plugin's installation settings or shares does not move it.
